title: Exact Escape Times of Langton's Ant in Four Rows
description: Computer-assisted exact first-exit maxima for all initial colorings and internal poses: S(4,n)=34n-150 for every n>=13, with every smaller value determined. A closed persistent-response catalog and an integer induction resolve Etse's four-row linear-bound conjecture. Independent finite implementations verify the certificates. This is not a proof of the unrestricted Highway Conjecture.
